scope: Prepare inactive bounded Google Calendar/Drive/People metadata reads and exact resource/receipt validation; no credentials, grant, route or provider activation.
riskAnalysis: STRICT credential-adjacent tool boundary. Explicit trusted authorization/transport injection only; no new authority issuance or runtime reachability. Frozen offline tests and independent source reviews required; real account access remains unavailable.

threatModel.assets: Owner/workspace source-bound Google resource metadata and truthful evidence; existing encrypted OAuth and Gmail isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Future trusted gateway authorization and transport versus model-selected resource inputs and untrusted provider outputs.
threatModel.abuseCases: Cross-workspace/resource/deployment substitution, stale/unconfirmed authority, path redirects, secret/error leakage, unsupported dates, fabricated all-day overlap, malformed provider fields, timeout/revocation.
threatModel.mitigations: No default credentials or transport/route/grant; exact allowlists/bindings and pre/post equality; fixed GET endpoints;32KB/3s bounds/cancel/abort; finite projections; full receipt hash; explicit local-date uncertainty.

rollback: Remove inactive module and mandatory references, regenerate release lock. No Google credentials or grants created, no provider mutation/cleanup needed. Preserve original failed probes and existing Gmail.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Reject impossible Gregorian/time fields, reversed/mismatched timed intervals, malformed pagination and unexpected identity; finite MIME projection.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact subject/workspace/task/source/deployment/release/connection revision and authority equality before/after.
negativePaths.concurrency: No grant issuance or persistence; future authoritative gateway must supply current policy, concurrent revision drift denies result.
negativePaths.cancellation: Whole operation signal and3s deadline; transport aborted finally; cancelled evidence never accepted.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker integration; future route remains disabled pending durable journal integration.
negativePaths.api-outage: Finite sanitized failure, no retries, no default fetch or provider credentials.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Unconfirmed/revoked credentials and absent/foreign resource bindings deny.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model dispatch, paid approvals, browser sessions or financial operations.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Preserve38/45 earlier focused results and failed date probes separately; final47 checks and frozenSTRICT required.

defects.rootCause: New prepared provider projection initially used Date.parse normalization, inherited MIME lookup and timezone-unsafe all-day overlap assumptions.
defects.detectionGap: Synthetic happy-path timestamps and MIME values did not represent malformed provider bodies or calendar-local dates.
defects.regression: Permanent impossible date/MIME/path/interval/deployment/pagination/abort/receipt/local-date cases plus independent probes.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use actual provider field contracts and preserve uncertainty; never infer genuine account access from injected fixtures.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing gateway extension preparation only; no competing journal, credentials or authorization layer.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Google owner OAuth remains permanently unconfirmed; module and focused tests added to exact release and mandatory contract coverage.
proactiveReview.threats: Untrusted resources/provider outputs, cross-tenant/identity/release substitution, prompt injection via metadata, stale authority and response fabrication.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Fixed GET/small metadata only; unsupported input fails closed, all-day overlap explicitly uncertain; no activation or automatic retries.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: 47 focused tests including stream bounds, timeout, revoke/change after dispatch, malformed provider content and no default transport.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Auditor and QA actual source review; corrected impossible dates, MIME integrity and timezone findings. Final QA47/47; no real Google API calls.
proactiveReview.recovery: Cancel and abort local operation without authority resurrection; future real gateway must use existing durable receipts and revocation.
proactiveReview.readiness: Inactive preparation only. Owner consent, confirmed credential/refresh, selected resources, gateway audit integration and real-provider verification remain necessary.
